name: U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd.
summary: U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. provides entertainment services. It operates through five segments: Content Distribution Business, Store Services Business, Communications Business, Business Systems Business, and Energy Business. It offers video distribution services; and provides, sells, and installs store solutions, including music distribution, as well as develops and manages music copyrights. The company also provides business management services for hotels, hospitals, golf courses, etc., as well as develops, manufactures, and sells management systems and automatic payment machines.
